gapReason.reason: The row is the deck's MIGRATIONS and SEED DATA - the fifty-three schema and transform migrations under mod/core/data/ and the yml fixtures beside them. The port has no migration history because the port has no Rails: its schema is the port's own (db/schema.sqlite.sql, which the fetch test storage installs) and the deck's data is the seed corpus the port reads (src/card/auth/boot-seed.ts). So the fifty-three `up`/`down` methods the port does not carry are the migration scripts themselves, and the fifty-seven that measure INERT-API are the migration and transform files' own helpers. The port binds no migration method under any name, and the row's own label says so: "58 migration files, real.yml/test.yml/recode.yml, 7 fixtures".
